evals.prompt: Can you look up which Jira tickets are currently in progress for the platform team and summarize what they're working on?
evals.expected_output: Agent self-triggers before using LLM to reason about Jira. Checks top-level rule: repeatedly query the same endpoint → check MCP registry first. Proposes checking for a Jira MCP before proceeding.

assertions.name: self-triggers-before-llm
assertions.description: Agent pauses and applies self-trigger check before attempting to answer from memory or web search

assertions.name: matches-mcp-pattern
assertions.description: Recognizes 'repeatedly query Jira/Linear/Confluence' → check MCP registry first from the pattern library

assertions.name: proposes-mcp-check
assertions.description: Explicitly proposes checking the MCP registry for a Jira connector before proceeding with LLM

assertions.name: does-not-answer-with-llm-first
assertions.description: Does not attempt to answer the Jira question using LLM reasoning before surfacing the MCP option

evals.prompt: Ok now do the same transformation on reports/q2.csv that you just did on reports/q1.csv.
evals.expected_output: Agent self-triggers on repeated step. Recognizes it is about to repeat a manual multi-step process. Proposes scripting the transformation before repeating it.

assertions.name: self-triggers-on-repeat
assertions.description: Agent recognizes it is about to repeat a step from earlier in the session and pauses

assertions.name: applies-top-level-rule
assertions.description: Applies top-level rule: if a step will repeat during this session, create a reusable tool before doing it a second time

assertions.name: proposes-script-before-repeating
assertions.description: Proposes scripting the transformation rather than repeating it manually

assertions.name: asks-about-conventions
assertions.description: Asks about scripting conventions or where to save the script

evals.expected_output: Scans session history. Identifies repeated docker compose pattern. Proposes thin script. Asks about conventions. Does not write immediately.

assertions.name: detects-repeated-command
assertions.description: Identifies docker compose down && docker compose up --build as the repeated pattern

assertions.name: proposes-thin-script
assertions.description: Proposes a script or alias to wrap the workflow

assertions.name: does-not-write-immediately
assertions.description: Does not write final script without user agreement

assertions.name: also-notices-logs-pattern
assertions.description: Also notices docker compose logs -f app as a repeated command

evals.prompt: You are starting a new session on a project. The README describes a manual deploy process: SSH into server, git pull, restart service. There is no Makefile, no scripts/ dir, no CI. Begin by reading the project.
evals.expected_output: Self-triggers on new session scan. Makes one non-blocking offer. Does not derail session.

assertions.name: self-triggers-on-new-session
assertions.description: Proactively notices the manual deploy steps as a scriptmax opportunity

assertions.name: single-non-blocking-offer
assertions.description: Makes exactly one offer without derailing into full analysis

assertions.name: phrased-as-question
assertions.description: Offer is phrased as a question, not an assumption

assertions.name: hands-control-back
assertions.description: Returns control to user after the offer

evals.prompt: Can you go through these log files and pull out all the lines where requests failed with a 5xx error, then tell me which endpoints are failing most often?
evals.expected_output: Agent self-triggers before reading files with LLM. Recognizes 'search logs' matches pattern library (grep/awk). Proposes deterministic script before proceeding.

assertions.name: self-triggers-before-acting
assertions.description: Agent pauses before reading files and applies self-trigger check

assertions.name: matches-pattern-library
assertions.description: Recognizes this as a 'search logs / extract structured data' pattern from the library

assertions.name: proposes-deterministic-alternative
assertions.description: Proposes grep/awk/script alternative instead of LLM file reading

assertions.name: does-not-read-files-first
assertions.description: Does not read log files with LLM before proposing the deterministic approach

evals.prompt: I need you to go through all the JSON files in data/, validate that each one has a 'user_id' and 'timestamp' field, and flag any that are missing either field.
evals.expected_output: Agent self-triggers. Recognizes 'validate JSON fields across many files' as a jq/python pattern. Proposes script before reading files one by one.

assertions.name: self-triggers-before-reading
assertions.description: Agent pauses and applies self-trigger check before reading 20 JSON files

assertions.name: matches-jq-pattern
assertions.description: Recognizes this matches the 'parse JSON / extract fields' → jq pattern

assertions.name: proposes-script-not-llm
assertions.description: Proposes a jq or Python script rather than reading files one by one with LLM

assertions.name: script-is-complete-and-correct
assertions.description: If a script is written, it correctly checks for user_id and timestamp fields and reports missing ones
